_comment: TRELLIS image-to-mesh, the Stable3DGen branch. USE THIS WHEN THE ASSET SHIPS INTO THE EU, UK OR SOUTH KOREA: TRELLIS is MIT with no territory clause, unlike Hunyuan3D, and unlike the TripoSG copy vendored in this pack, whose licence file carries the same exclusion (see docs/guide/licensing). Unlike img2mesh_triposg.json this needs NO cut-out: the pipeline runs rembg/u2net itself, so a plain grey-background concept render works. Two things worth knowing before you change numbers. mesh_simplify is a KEEP ratio, not a removal ratio -- 0.95 keeps 95% of the faces, so it barely simplifies and the Decimate node below is what actually meets a budget. And this branch applies an axis transform that the plain TRELLIS nodes do not, so if a mesh from here disagrees on orientation with a TripoSG or Hunyuan3D one, that is why. Needs the 'trellis' weight group: scripts/fetch_models.py --download --group trellis. Note the pipeline type is the generic DIFFUSERS_PIPE, shared with 14 other loaders, so ComfyUI will happily let you wire a TripoSG or Hunyuan loader in here and fail at run time rather than at validation -- keep node 2 as it is.
